title: G's TV
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Watch video pictures while parked. A home screen of sources: Spelunkr (spelunkr.tv's channels of programmes on the Internet Archive, no DRM, no sign-in) with CH up / CH down, swipe up / down to change channel, a channel banner, a 2-hour guide with category filters and a fullscreen picture; and your own sources: direct links to one MP4 file (H.264 video) each, sent from your phone with a QR code or a 6-digit code (end-to-end encrypted), checked by the car before they are saved, resumed where you left off. Hold a source to rename it, send a new link or remove it. Web pages and players are refused. Decoded in the app (WebAssembly H.264). Video only, no sound yet. Parked only: the picture shows only while the speed is known and at most 3 km/h and the selector is in P, otherwise 'Video available when parked'. Optional, off by default: Play in cluster, HUD test and Play in HUD (parked only, one at a time, each needs two taps; the HUD ones start off every time; they need the separate Cluster renderer tool from the Store). Needs mgu-uplink internet

config.comment: Spelunkr: lineupUrl and channel (the first channel shown). streamUrl: one http(s) MP4 with H.264 video, played at the start instead of the home screen (testing). relay: the public phone page for Add source (https, holds no secrets); mailbox: the ntfy server the phone and the car meet on (messages are AES-256-GCM sealed). <data>/tv.json with lineupUrl / channel / streamUrl overrides these on the car.
